description: Defines RAII classes (StreamGuard, OptionalStreamGuard, MultiStreamGuard) for managing CUDA stream and device context in a scoped manner within the c10 namespace.

classes.name: StreamGuard
classes.description: An RAII class that manages setting and resetting CUDA streams and devices within a scope.

classes.name: OptionalStreamGuard
classes.description: An RAII class that manages setting a CUDA stream optionally and resets on destruction.

classes.name: MultiStreamGuard
classes.description: An RAII class that manages multiple CUDA streams across devices, resetting them on scope exit.

methods.name: reset_stream
methods.description: Resets the current stream to a specified stream.

methods.name: original_stream
methods.description: Returns the stream set at construction.

methods.name: current_stream
methods.description: Returns the most recent stream set via this guard.

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Returns the current device set via this guard.

methods.name: original_device
methods.description: Returns the device set at the most recent reset or at construction.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the guard to an uninitialized state.
